description: Convert a GPA on one grade scale to the nearest band on another, so a GPA from one country can be read as a UK class or an Australian grade. Inputs: gpa (the GPA to convert, 0 to 7 and at or below the top of from_scale), from_scale (the scale the GPA is on, default us4) and optional to_scale (the scale to convert to; leave it out to convert to both the uk-classification and australia-hd scales). The GPA is read as a share of the top grade point on its own scale, then the nearest band on the target scale is returned with its percentage range and grade points. This is a common comparison, not an official conversion, so check the target school's table. Example prompt: "I have a 3.5 GPA on the US 4.0 scale. What is that in the UK?"

from_scale.description: Grade scale id the GPA is on: "us4", "us4plus", "ontario-college", "uk-classification", "australia-hd" or "weighted-5.0". Defaults to "us4".

gpa.description: The GPA to convert, between 0 and 7. It must be at or below the top grade point of from_scale.

to_scale.description: Grade scale id to convert to: "us4", "us4plus", "ontario-college", "uk-classification", "australia-hd" or "weighted-5.0". Leave it out to convert to both the uk-classification and australia-hd scales.

name: convert_gpa_scale

conversions.description: One entry per target scale, in the order they were converted.

letter.description: The nearest band on the target scale.

max_percent.description: The highest percentage the band covers on the target scale.

min_percent.description: The lowest percentage the band covers on the target scale.

points.description: The grade points the band is worth on the target scale.

scale.description: The scale id the GPA was converted to.

scale_name.description: The name of the scale the GPA was converted to.

from_max_points.description: The top grade point of the scale the GPA was on.

from_scale.description: The scale id the GPA was on.

from_scale_name.description: The name of the scale the GPA was on.

title: Convert a GPA to another scale
